text.hero_title: Reading the Signals. Revealing the Direction.
text.hero_paragraph: Soil Genesis listens to living soil signals and develops research, instruments and restoration applications to support soil, vegetation, land function and human agency.
text.vision_h2_1: What Grows Above Depends on What Lives Below
text.vision_p_1: Restoring land and the capacity to act
text.vision_h3_1: A Future Where Technology Serves Life
text.vision_p_2: Food sovereignty connects the health of land with the health and independence of people. It is a major initiative within our broader work to restore the conditions that allow living systems to flourish.
text.vision_p_3: We work toward a future in which:
text.vision_li_1: People grow healthy food close to home
text.vision_li_3: Growers build lasting relationships with their land
text.vision_p_4: Restoring the relationship between people, land and life.
text.journey_p_1: Scientific inquiry, creative experience and reciprocal care
text.journey_p_5: Fungi, microbes, roots, water and minerals form changing relationships. We study the system through those relationships.
text.journey_p_6: The Soil Signal Explorer translates measured living-soil signals into sound and image. Changes become perceptible alongside the data, offering another way to experience living systems.
text.journey_p_8: Continuous observation follows changes that a single visit or sample may miss. Sound and image are translations of those measurements.
text.why-us_p_1: Our development follows a living loop. Each observation informs the work; each intervention becomes an opportunity to learn.
text.why-us_p_2: Record changing conditions in living soil over time.
text.why-us_p_3: Examine patterns alongside the conditions and independent measurements that give them meaning.
text.why-us_p_4: Develop ways to support soil structure, biology and vegetation.
text.why-us_p_5: Compare what changed with the starting conditions and relevant references.
text.why-us_p_6: Let the response inform the next decision.
text.why-us_p_7: Keep traceable measurements, thoughtful comparisons and clear accounts of what the work establishes.
text.global_p_2: Listening is the beginning of a relationship.
text.science_h2_1: Built Around the Living System Itself.
text.science_p_1: Sensing, interpretation and restoration development work together, from the soil beneath a garden to questions spanning landscapes.
text.science_p_5: The Soil Signal Explorer (SSE) records changes in living soil's bioelectrochemical conditions. It adds continuous temporal context between laboratory, biological and ecological measurements. For carbon applications, authoritative carbon measurements remain the anchor.
text.science_p_6: Our research explores how to restore supporting conditions for soil, roots and fungi. Biological products and delivery tools are pathways within this wider development work.
text.science_p_7: We are developing applications for growers, restoration programs and landscape portfolios, connecting local observations with the questions that guide land stewardship.
text.cascade_h2_1: The Cascade: From Soil to Flourishing
text.cascade_p_1: Restoration begins below ground and reaches into daily life.
text.cascade_p_2: Our purpose follows the relationships connecting soil, vegetation, ecosystems and communities.
text.cascade_p_8: Restore supporting conditions. Strengthen the capacity for life.
text.solutions_p: We are building a financially successful science, technology and development enterprise. Commercial strength sustains research, reliable delivery and wider access.
text.solutions_sb_p: Commission research and development around a useful question, with agreed comparisons, findings and deliverables. Development partnerships can connect that work to a field, restoration program or landscape portfolio.
text.solutions_gc_p: Work with us toward useful instruments, restoration applications and program delivery. Deployments, data services and licensing can grow from agreed development work; custom biological products remain one pathway.
text.solutions_ss_p: Each well-documented project can connect measured responses with conditions and independent outcomes. This growing reference record is a compounding asset for research, interpretation and future applications.
text.about_p_1: An operating research instrument. A growing body of evidence.
text.about_p_4: Current research uses structured comparisons to investigate what measured responses reveal about living soil and how that knowledge can support useful applications.
text.about_p_6: Continuous measurements of changing soil conditions.
text.about_p_8: Sound and image linked to the measurement record.
text.about_p_9: Comparative research with documented conditions and independent references.
text.cta_p_1: Commission research, explore a development partnership or support a restoration program. We welcome growers, community partners and institutions working across landscapes and portfolios.
text.cta_p_2: A steward finances agreed work. Soil Genesis contributes its instruments, research and delivery; the steward receives the agreed findings, technology or program. Investment participation and technology rights are negotiated separately. This allows growers and communities to benefit without their purchasing power determining the reach.

html.journey_p_2: We did not set out to build a product. We set out to listen.
html.journey_p_3: We regard microbes, fungi and plants as sentient participants in the living systems we learn from. Their responses, relationships and functions contribute to our work. Our reciprocal commitment is to restore supporting conditions, reduce harm and attend to how they respond.
html.global_p_1: “Soil is alive, and its life reveals its state.”
html.cascade_p_3: Fungi, microbes and roots contribute to nutrient cycling, aggregation, water movement and living soil structure.
html.cascade_p_4: Living soil can support root development, nutrient access and the ability of vegetation to withstand stress.
html.cascade_p_5: Plants help sustain the insects, pollinators, birds and wildlife that share the land.
html.cascade_p_6: Local food production can strengthen access to nourishment and people's relationship with the land.
html.cascade_p_7: Food sovereignty builds the capacity to grow, decide and act together, with less dependence on outside support.
html.cascade_p_9: We develop and test practical ways to support these relationships, so ecological restoration and human independence can grow together.
html.about_p_2: Soil Genesis has developed, operated, and field-tested multiple generations of the Soil Signal Explorer.
html.about_p_5: The SSE is an operating research instrument. Interpretation and restoration applications remain under development.
html.about_p_10: Company: Soil Genesis DAO LLC | Jurisdiction: Wyoming, United States
html.cta_p_3: Begin with the question or place you care about, and the useful result you want to work toward.
